headline: Paks Unit Three Is Back on the Grid
deck: MTI said Paks Unit 3 turbine No. 6 was synchronised late Saturday and began producing. Péter Magyar said four of eight turbines were running on Sunday and that the plant could reach 2,000 MW by Wednesday. Cernavodă, on the same river, did not reconnect. That 23 August call settles NO.
body: MTI reported at 23:56 on 22 August that electricity production from turbine No. 6 of Paks Unit 3 had started late Saturday evening after a successful connection to the national grid [E1]. At the moment of connection the turbine was running at 22 megawatts, to be raised by one megawatt a minute toward 240 [E1]. Plant output, MTI said, could rise from around 500 megawatts late Saturday toward about 750 megawatts by Sunday morning, with all eight turbines possibly running by Wednesday [E1].

MVM Paksi Atomerőmű, in a plant announcement carried by Portfolio on Sunday morning, said one of Unit 3’s turbine-generators was connected at 23:00 on 22 August [E2]. The plant attributed the restart to a rise in the Danube and to construction of a riverbed sill, which it said had restored the technical conditions for starting previously shut units [E2]. Péter Magyar, in Sunday remarks, said four of eight turbines were producing and that by Wednesday the plant could again generate 2,000 megawatts, covering about 35 percent of Hungarian consumption [E3].

Cernavodă, downstream on the same drought, did not reconnect a unit by 23:59 Europe/Bucharest on 23 August [E4]. Romanian emergency measures around dredging and extra Olt releases were still in train [E4]. The 23 August Clank & Slop call required an actual synchronization confirmed by Nuclearelectrica, Transelectrica, a ministry or a named wire. That artifact was not retrieved. The call settles NO.

Sunday’s Hungarian record is a named turbine, a named clock, and a mid-week full-output claim [E1][E2][E3]. Whether MAVIR or the plant prints ≥1,900 megawatts on 26 August is the next public test [E1][E3]. Paks is producing again. Cernavodă is not [E1][E4].
